name: esd-clamp-cv
description: Issue #12: small-signal AC capacitance at the PAD node of the real GGNMOS ESD clamp from layout/gds/gf180_tmds_pad_min.gds, as a function of device size, at 0 V and at the TMDS operating bias, across the full PVT matrix. Feeds the ESD-vs-capacitance verdict in design/esd-capacitance-budget.md; not itself an ESD qualification (no tester, no parts -- see the design doc).
claim: spec/tmds-tx.md#dr-0005 -- the <=2 pF/pad budget (ESD clamp + pad parasitic combined), specifically the clamp half of that budget as a function of clamp size, at both 0 V and the DR-0002/DR-0006 2.8-3.3 V operating bias.

cap_w444_opv.description: sanity ceiling only (50 pF) -- catches a broken AC probe (open circuit / zero current), not a DR-0005 compliance gate. The 2 pF budget comparison is a design-doc computation across every corner's measured value, not a per-corner pass/fail on this record.
